PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on a single behavior. RATIONALE: Single Arrange-Act-Assert gives precise root cause. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Check distinct 'Act' operations. DECISION RULES: (1) Count 'Act' operations -> only fPHeapMin0.retiraMin() is invoked as the act. (2) Test name does not suggest multiple operations. (3) The test contains a single Arrange-Act-Assert pattern (setup, single call, exception assertion). VERDICT: compliant because the method tests one behavior (calling retiraMin and expecting a NullPointerException).

PRINCIPLE: Tests must not depend on execution order. RATIONALE: Independent tests allow reordering/parallel runs. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for @Before/@After or shared mutable state. DECISION RULES: (1) No @Before/@After present in the shown snippet but method uses only local variables. (2) No static/instance shared mutable state visible. VERDICT: compliant because the test uses only local variables and does not rely on external or shared state.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Test suites should include happy path and error scenarios. RATIONALE: Ensures robustness by testing both success and failure. EVALUATION CRITERIA: For each method under test there should be at least two tests (happy path + error). DECISION RULES: (1) The class contains only this single test method; while it tests an exceptional flow, there is no corresponding happy-path test in the provided code. (2) No assertThrows/@Test(expected=...) paired with a normal-case test exists. VERDICT: non-compliant because only an error scenario is present and no happy-path test accompanies it.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should validate inputs at boundaries. RATIONALE: Many bugs appear at edges. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for empty, zero, negative, max values. DECISION RULES: (1) Test uses an array of size 9 and specific indices but does not test empty heap, zero-length array, negative indices or other boundary inputs. (2) No 'empty'/'zero' naming. VERDICT: non-compliant because no boundary cases (empty heap, size 0, etc.) are exercised in this method.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be self-contained and reuse helpers; remove duplication. RATIONALE: Modular tests reduce duplication and improve maintainability. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Presence of helper methods or constants. DECISION RULES: (1) No private helper methods or constants are present in the shown snippet. (2) Only a single test is present so duplication cannot be seen, and the method has multiple setup lines rather than factored helpers. VERDICT: non-compliant because no helper methods or constants are used to modularize setup; setup is inline.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple properties. RATIONALE: Superficial assertions may miss faults. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Count assertions and check depth. PRINCIPLE: Avoid @Ignore or commented-out tests. RATIONALE: Ignored tests hide problems. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Search for @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out @Test.
